answer.headline: Checkout start after add-to-cart declined due to a tracking issue affecting the Web operating system.
explanation: Checkout start after add-to-cart dropped significantly while purchases without checkout increased for the Web operating system starting from Fri 18 Dec 2020.
This tracking finding directly affects the metric and explains the observed drop.
The issue is isolated to the Web operating system segment.
answer.next_step: Investigate the analytics tag implementation and event firing logic for checkout starts on the Web platform.
